arguments.text: Strong start. Settle now, long race, ease into race rhythm.

6000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000, last 1000 m out). Target: near-even shaft power about 190-200 W (pod CP 189, 18 kJ reserve; may be 10-25 pct off), a touch harder into the current, a touch easier with it. Check CP with heart rate: at steady effort below CP HR levels off, above it keeps climbing. Watch for weed (speed drops at same pod power -> clear_rudder test), pod drift (pod power changes but HR and GPS speed do not), radio course changes (set_race_distance + tell). Final push: spend leftover reserve from about 600-800 m out, finish cue at about 400 m.

arguments.text: Speed dropped too. Back-stroke now to clear the rudder.

t=545 s: paddler said boat heavy / rudder. push_local fell from about -0.22 to -0.33 near 480 s while pod rose to 215 W (piece) and boat power fell 137->129: share ~0.60 vs 0.66. Cued clear_rudder at 545 s. Check after: push_local back to ~-0.22 and share ~0.66 => weed cleared. If not: pod drift high or other drag. Speed_loss watch threshold -0.2 was too coarse (drop was ~-0.12).

Plan: pod ~205-208 W on with-current legs (ground pace ~143), ~215 W into current (ground ~164), set by a pace target right after each turn (targets persist through turns, so re-cue each leg). Spend remaining reserve from ~700 m out; finish cue ~350-400 m. Keep watching for weed again (speed_loss watch), pod drift (pod vs HR/GPS), radio course changes.
